The '''Sledgehammer''' was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] model manufactured by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that saw use during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Designed for destroying immobile and armored objectives such as satellites and bunkers, the Sledgehammer was designed to be more maneuverable than similar bombers but had a weaker hull. It could carry missiles or torpedoes in addition to its [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and could carry mines or drones as auxiliary systems.<ref name="GS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sledgehammer is one of the four bomber models available to Republic players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It costs 5,000 Fleet Requisition to unlock, and is the Republic faction's balanced bomber, with the [[B-5 Decimus]] as its Imperial counterpart.<ref name="GS" />
